formalized_ms: Symmetry of semialgebraic bounded domains with compact quotient
gap: Kollár–Pardon characterization of semialgebraic universal covers (D×ℂ^m×F) and its corollaries are absent; Lean is only the companion bounded-domain symmetry theorem.
quote: A nonempty connected bounded semialgebraic subset, relatively open in a complex affine algebraic set, is smooth and biholomorphic to a bounded symmetric domain whenever a discrete group acts properly and holomorphically with compact quotient.

gap: Deterministic algorithm, exact values and optimal positional strategies, stochastic and parity extensions; Lean has only the Monte Carlo (prob ≥7/8) algorithm plus Truffet counterexample.
quote: The formalized result gives one randomized algorithm for the complete zero-threshold winning set of every finite mean-payoff game with signed binary weights.

formalized_ms: Boundedness and persistence of weakly reversible mass-action systems
gap: Classwise uniform permanence: one compact convex absorbing set per stoichiometric class; Lean bounds depend on the initial state.
quote: A global forward solution exists, and one $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$ bounds every concentration of every global forward solution between $\varepsilon$ and $\varepsilon^{-1}$ for all nonnegative times.

formalized_ms: A Sharp Threshold Bound for Monotone Graph Properties
gap: r-uniform hypergraph influence bound and threshold width O_r((log n)^{-r/(r-1)}), incl. nonmonotone variance bound; Lean covers graphs (r=2) only.
quote: the formalization proves that the edge-probability interval between probabilities $\varepsilon$ and $1-\varepsilon$ has width at most $2^{19}\log(1/(2\varepsilon))/(\log n)^2$.

formalized_ms: The Bass trace conjecture and the characteristic-zero Kaplansky idempotent conjecture
gap: ℓ¹(G) Banach-algebra idempotents and finite support on finite-order classes; Lean covers only the complex group ring ℂ[G] (plus torsion-free Kaplansky corollary).
quote: The formalization proves the complex Bass trace conjecture for every group: the Hattori–Stallings trace of each virtual class of finitely generated projective right $\mathbb C[G]$-modules vanishes on conjugacy classes of infinite-order elements.

formalized_ms: The free energy of the Ising random perceptron + The free energy of the spherical random perceptron
gap: Ising free-energy convergence and Borel potentials absent (only finiteness of variational value); spherical companion formula is fully formalized.
quote: This is a supporting well-definedness result. It does not assert convergence of the finite-system pressure or the paper's extension to all bounded Borel log-potentials.

formalized_ms: A CH obstruction to a prescribed categoricity threshold
gap: ZFC eventual categoricity theorem (uniform threshold μ(λ) transfer) absent; Lean is only the CH counterexample to the prescribed Hanf threshold.
quote: The later canonical-point obstruction and the separate eventual-categoricity theorem are not included.

formalized_ms: Generalized ionization energies for full Coulomb atoms
gap: Excess-charge bound n ≤ Z+CM for molecules and neutral-atom ionization/radius bounds absent; Lean gives generalized ionization energy and radius asymptotics.
quote: The formalization gives the large-ionization asymptotics for the full nonrelativistic two-spin Coulomb atom.

formalized_ms: Strongly rational unitary vertex operator algebras and conformal nets
gap: Complete rationality of the net, unitarizability of simple modules, braided unitary tensor equivalence Rep(V)≃Rep^f(A_V), extension classification.
quote: The selected statement does not include complete rationality of the net, unitarizability of all simple modules, the braided tensor equivalence, or the classification of local extensions described in the paper.

formalized_ms: The Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis via elementary expansions
gap: Semi-model structure and equivalence with the homotopy theory of spaces (the homotopy hypothesis); Lean states the paper's thm:main, elementary expansions are weak equivalences.
quote: The later semi-model structure and full comparison with the homotopy theory of spaces are not included.

formalized_ms: A counterexample to integer-degree harmonic dimension comparison
gap: Three-dimensional metrics for all large k with ≥(k+2)^2 (c(k+1)^2) harmonic functions; Lean is a single even n≥8 counterexample.
quote: The formalized result disproves the proposed Euclidean upper comparison for dimensions of harmonic functions with integer polynomial growth.
